title: Signup Worker throws 500s
summary: Our edge signup endpoint returns 500 Internal Server Error for some clients. Logs show it dies on certain requests. Make it return correct status codes.
brief: src/handler.js is an edge-worker style request handler for POST /api/signup. Some clients get HTTP 500 instead of a proper response. Fix the handler so it never throws: malformed or empty JSON must return 400, wrong content types must return 415, valid signups return 201, and unsupported methods must be handled correctly per HTTP semantics. Keep the public API (module.exports.handle) unchanged.

hiddenNames: malformed JSON returns 400 with error body
content-type with charset parameter is accepted
JSON that is not an object returns 400
missing headers object does not throw
